class.name: SteeringWheelHats
class.brief_description: A steering wheel's hat switch and buttons.
class.description: Reads a steering wheel's hat switch (its D-pad), so the game can tell its directions apart from the wheel's own buttons with the same numbers (Godot reports a hat as joypad buttons 11 to 14). On Windows it also reads the wheel's buttons by their own numbers, since a wheel read as an Xbox gamepad can be renumbered. It only listens, so it's safe to use alongside [SteeringWheel] and in menus.

method.name: get_buttons
method.description: Returns the wheel's buttons held now, by their own numbers ([code]0[/code] being the first).

method.name: get_hat
method.description: Returns the directions held, as a mask (up [code]1[/code], right [code]2[/code], down [code]4[/code], left [code]8[/code]; [code]0[/code] when centred), or [code]-1[/code] when no hat is being read or nothing has been heard yet.

method.name: reads_buttons
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the wheel's own buttons are read here (Windows).

method.name: watch
method.description: Starts reading the hat switch of the wheel with these USB IDs. Returns [code]true[/code] if the wheel has a hat to read.
